description: What replaces guidance that an IWSDK release retired. `iwsdk dev up` removes a retired skill or file only when it is listed here, and writes what replaces it in the same run, so a refresh never leaves a project with less guidance than it had. List a retired skill by name with the skills that replace it, for both .claude/skills and .agents/skills (an empty list retires it outright). List a retired file by path with the units, or the coding tools whose whole guidance, replaces it. Every unit in legacy-hashes.json (written by releases before 1.2) that this release no longer ships must be listed; the guidance build fails otherwise. It cannot check units that only 1.2 and later releases wrote, so list those too when you retire one: without an entry, dev up keeps them, and only `agents sync` and `upgrade` remove them.
